## Interpretation

The endpoint-interval implementations agree closely with each other.  Arb ball enclosures are wider on the coarse partition.  Refinement behavior is reported directly rather than attributed to arithmetic precision or to a failure of the legacy mpmath calculation.  The paper uses only the conservative Arb bound.

Classification: `PEABODY_ENCLOSURE_RECONCILIATION_PASS`.
